name: benign-corpus
description: Hand-written benign tool metadata used to measure MCP008 false positives.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system.

path.description: Absolute or relative path of the file to read

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content.

path.description: Path of the file to write

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content.

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files matching a glob pattern. Ignores files matched by .gitignore rules when respect_gitignore is true.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve metadata about a file: size, creation time, last modified time and permissions.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Fails if the destination already exists.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository, newest first.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get details of a commit, including the diff of every changed file.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories using GitHub's code search syntax.

tools.name: send_message

tools.description: Fetch recent messages from a channel. Older messages are paginated; pass the cursor from the previous response.

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message.

name.description: Emoji name without colons, e.g. thumbsup

tools.name: query

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the current database schema.

tools.description: Apply a pending database migration. Runs inside a transaction and rolls back on error.

tools.description: Fetch a URL from the internet and return its contents as Markdown.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return the top results with titles, URLs and snippets.

tools.name: navigate

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element on the page.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the browser console and return the result.

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes in the knowledge graph based on a query.

query.description: Text matched against names, types and observations

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current time in a specific timezone.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert time between timezones.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show the working tree status.

tools.description: Record changes to the repository with a commit message.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show the commit log, most recent first.

tools.description: Run the test suite with pytest and return a summary of failures.

tools.description: Format source code in place with the project's formatter.

tools.description: Create a calendar event.

tools.description: Search the user's mailbox using Gmail query syntax.

tools.description: Append content blocks to a page.

Check system health. Output format:
status: ok | degraded
